story.title: GIS in Morocco since 1988
story.lead: Founded in 1988, Geomatic is a Moroccan leader in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), cloud computing, and big data solutions. With over three decades of expertise, Geomatic helps organizations leverage geospatial intelligence to make smarter, data-driven decisions.
paragraphs: Beyond GIS, the company specializes in satellite imagery, image processing, and GPS-based geolocation, offering end-to-end solutions from software distribution and consulting to full-scale system implementation.

Geomatic has delivered major projects across Morocco, West Africa, and the Gulf region, working with governments and international partners such as the United Nations, USAID, GIZ, and the World Bank to drive innovation and digital transformation through GIS technology.

cards.label: Our mission
cards.text: To empower organizations with intelligent geospatial solutions that transform data into actionable insight. Geomatic is dedicated to advancing sustainable development and digital transformation through cutting-edge GIS technologies.

cards.label: Our vision
cards.text: To be the leading force driving geospatial innovation and digital transformation across Africa. Geomatic envisions a future where spatial intelligence shapes smarter, more sustainable, and more connected communities.
